task.name: fixed-camera continuous natural-process video
task.scene_policy: one continuous scene with no intended camera motion
task.replicate_unit: seed nested within scene_id and model_id
task.horizon_policy: score matched prefixes from one rollout when the model permits; report separately generated requested durations as a separate experiment
task.window_policy: fixed wall-clock duration shared across horizons

headline_candidates.question: Do rigid scene anchors remain fixed at adjacent and long temporal baselines?
Does non-trivial motion persist in the intended region?
headline_candidates.applicability: requires intended-motion region and observable texture

headline_candidates.question: Does apparent transport follow the annotated image-plane path?
Does material cross the annotated boundary toward the intended target while support remains fixed?
headline_candidates.applicability: only source/destination prompts with a visible crossing boundary

headline_candidates.question: Does the process avoid exact or near-exact long-lag replay?
Does the rollout avoid reset seams or discontinuous state jumps?

context_axes.primary_evidence: blind human label with validated VLM triage
context_axes.purpose: prevent semantic substitution from being interpreted as good flow
validate whether mechanistic differences matter perceptually

mandatory_incumbents: VBench-Long subject/background slow-fast consistency when applicable
VBench-I2V source-image subject/background consistency for I2V
VBench-I2V or VBench-2.0 static-camera classification for I2V
VBench-2.0 mechanics or motion-rationality subset where prompts overlap

reporting.threshold_policy: freeze on development scenes and real-video anchors; evaluate on held-out scenes and models
